name: [Equip] Changes refused with 403
query: logs("service:equip-backend source:vercel (\"[INFO] api: POST\" OR \"[INFO] api: PUT\" OR \"[INFO] api: PATCH\" OR \"[INFO] api: DELETE\") \" 403 \"").index("*").rollup("count").last("1h") >= 5
message:
Five or more changes (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) were refused with 403 within an hour.

Somebody is trying to do their work and the server keeps saying no. On 21-22.11 this was the only director: the consent gate wanted the School Agreement and no screen asked for it (17 refusals grading one paper). Usual causes: a legal document owed with no screen for it (legal.consent_required), a role or membership the UI thinks the person has and the server does not.

Find the person from the request ids in the sample lines, then their legal_acceptances and memberships.

Notify: @supportequip@gmail.com
